taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perennial herbs 5-30 cm tall.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perennial.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaves die back over winter in cold climates.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Fragaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves basal, from a short crown.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Fragaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants spread by stolons.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves bright green, thin; sRGB by eye.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaf blade 3-foliolate, rarely pinnately 5-foliolate.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): three leaflets from one point (ternate), drawn palmate.

traits.division_order.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets undivided.

traits.leaflets.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 3-foliolate.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 1-5 cm, so the blade about as long.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petiole 3-20 cm.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 1-5 cm long.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 0.6-4 cm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets obovate, elliptic or broadly ovate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet apex obtuse.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margin obtusely or acutely incised-serrate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescence corymbiform.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 2-4 (or 5) flowers.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the flower cluster 2 cm to 5 cm across.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicel 1-3 cm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Fragaria vesca subsp. bracteata (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers 15.3-23.8 mm across.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white; sRGB by eye.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens about 20.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): aggregate fruit: achenes on a swollen red torus.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: fruit 1 cm to 2 cm long.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): aggregate fruit ripening red; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruit ovoid.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering April to June.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Fragaria vesca (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruiting June to September.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a low rosette of bright green three-parted toothed leaves on long stalks, small white flowers in loose clusters and small red strawberries.

allometry.note: 0.15 m tall at 3 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
